lines.text: The quick survey of a quiet harbour town begins at dawn, when the fishing boats drift back past the
lighthouse and the market stalls fold open their striped awnings. Gulls wheel over the quay while
merchants argue cheerfully about the price of mackerel, and a
baker carries warm loaves across the cobbles to the cafe on
the
corner. By noon the visitors arrive, and the narrow streets fill
with
the sound of voices, bicycle bells and distant music.

paragraph, and which words travel together across a page
boundary. A faithful reproduction must make exactly the same
decisions, because one different break early in a document
moves every line that follows it onto a different page.
